profile.title: PROFILE
profile.lead: I’m Arsenij, a front-end developer working in Shopify app technical support.
profile.desc: I’ve helped 100+ Shopify stores resolve widget and checkout issues. In my technical support work, I reproduce bugs, investigate theme scripts and app integrations, and fix cart, variant and storefront behavior. Alongside support, I build and customize front-end interfaces with React, TypeScript, JavaScript and CSS for store owners and agencies.

alcemi.description: Front-end development for Alcemi Shopping Agent, a Shopify app for conversational product discovery and customer support.
alcemi.overview: Alcemi Shopping Agent is a Shopify app that helps shoppers discover products and get support through a conversational interface. I worked at the startup as its main front-end developer. Unfortunately, the project was abandoned at launch.
alcemi.contribution: My work focused on the customer-facing interface: turning the shopping assistant experience into front-end screens and interactions. This preview shows an early version of the app, including the conversation entry screen and its product and support prompts.

komilfo.description: Website for Komilfo, a beauty salon in Lithuania. Services, gallery, multilingual pages and contact details.
komilfo.overview: Komilfo Beauty is a beauty salon in Lithuania. The website brings its services, gallery and contact information together so visitors can explore the salon and find how to get in touch.
komilfo.contribution: I worked on the website development, including the service pages, gallery, multilingual content and contact details. The layout puts the salon’s photography and services at the centre of the experience.

1man.description: Contributed to finishing the company’s landing page, helping bring the front-end work across the finish line.
1man.overview: 1MAN AI’s company landing page introduces the business and its offering. I joined the project to help finish the page rather than building the entire site from scratch.
1man.contribution: My contribution was to the final front-end implementation of the landing page, helping complete the work for the company. This project is included as a contribution to the finished page.
